title: Sentinel Apply Controller for batching/caching recommendations
creator: Aisha Mahoney
description: Introduce a Sentinel Apply Controller: a low-latency policy enforcer that stages and validates batching/cache configuration recommendations from Redwood Optimize before wide rollout. The controller must integrate with the Optimize suggestion stream, create ephemeral canary cohorts, evaluate telemetry against safety rules (latency P95, error-rate, quality regressions measured via prompt eval hooks, and unit-cost delta), and either commit, escalate for manual approval, or automatically rollback. Deliverables: controller service, policy DSL for gating thresholds, canary orchestration actor, observable dashboards, end-to-end tests, and runbook for ops. Key constraints: minimal added latency to apply path, predictable state reconciliation after crashes, and compatibility with Dedicated and Private deployments (config propagation via secure control channel).
acceptance_criteria: Controller can stage a suggested config and create canary cohorts of traffic split 1%-10%
Telemetry pipeline produces per-cohort metrics (latency P95, tail CPU/GPU utilization, token cost, error-rate) visible in Console
Policy DSL can express threshold and delta checks and supports composite rules (e.g., cost decrease allowed only if latency regressions < 5ms and quality delta < 0.5%)
Automated rollback triggers within 60s of crossing safety thresholds and returns system to previous config without dropped in-flight requests
Manual approval path integrates with Console reviewer workflow and records audit logs and approver in release history
End-to-end tests simulate a failing model variant and demonstrate safe abort of rollout and clean rollback
Works in Dedicated and Private modes using control-plane syncs and does not leak customer data into hosted telemetry stores
